Oral Ibuprofen Versus Intramuscular Ketorolac for Acute Musculoskeletal Back Pain in the Emergency Department: A Prospective Analysis. Ibuprofen and ketorolac are nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) commonly used to treat acute back pain in the Emergency Department (ED). Data comparing pain relief between oral and intramuscular administration at their proposed ceiling doses is lacking.
